papers.title_en: STST-JEPA: Shallow-Target Spatio-Temporal Joint Embedding Prediction Architecture For EEG Self-Supervised Learning
papers.authors: Roy Segal, Yoni Svechinsky, Tomer Fekete
papers.evidence: 面向认知任务分析的EEG自监督Transformer
papers.tldr: 脑龄作为新兴生物标志物，其与生理年龄的偏差可追踪神经精神负担，EEG因廉价便携且时域信息丰富成为理想载体。然而，跨站点异质性、小样本和非平稳性限制了现有脑龄模型在全年龄段的性能。STST-JEPA基于自监督transformer，在47,703个EEG会话上预训练，采用潜在预测与信号重建双重目标进行时空块掩码学习。冻结嵌入后探针年龄回归MAE为3.06年（r=0.924），微调后在性别分类、年龄预测及精神病理回归三项任务中均取得第一，年龄预测残差负相关于认知效率。该工作展示了EEG基础模型在脑龄估计等临床应用的潜力。
papers.abstract_en: Brain age - the age inferred from a physiological recording - is an emerging biomarker whose deviation from chronological age tracks neurological and psychiatric burden, and EEG is an attractive substrate for it because it is cheap, portable, and temporally rich. Yet EEG brain-age models must contend with cross-site montage heterogeneity, small labelled cohorts, and dominant subject-level non-stationarity, and few EEG foundation models have been shown to deliver competitive age regression across the full pediatric to older adult range in which such a biomarker would actually be deployed. We introduce STST-JEPA, a self-supervised transformer for resting-state and task EEG, pretrained on 47,703 sessions spanning ages 5-81 from the brain.space and Healthy Brain Network (HBN) corpora. The model combines a latent-prediction objective - predicting masked-token representations against an EMA-of-tokenizer target - with an auxiliary signal-reconstruction term, applied to 30-second multi-channel windows under spatiotemporal block masks. A lightweight attentive probe trained on frozen pretrained embeddings achieves a best held-out-validation mean absolute error of 3.06 years (r = 0.924) for age regression on 3,367 sessions, against a predict-the-mean baseline of approximately 10 years MAE. With light task-specific finetuning of the model's final layers, the same pretrained encoder achieves rank-1 placements - with the model's native 30-second windows - on the public NeuralBench x brain.space EEG leaderboard for sex classification (balanced accuracy 0.911), age prediction (r = 0.749), and psychopathology composite regression (r = 0.215). We further show that the model's age-prediction residual is negatively correlated with cognitive efficiency over several tasks we examined.
